messages:
Alex M: Seeing steady GPU mem climb on canary for redwood/model-serving after switching kernel picker to greedy. memory goes up ~120MB per hour, no active requests spike.
Sana R: Hmm. Is kv cache enabled? could be incremental cache growth + allocator fragmentation.
Alex M: KV cache is on (LRU=10000). Logs show evictions but cudaReservedMemory keeps increasing.
Mike T: Can you paste nvidia-smi/pynvml snapshot? Also what allocator — our largebuf allocator or default cudaMalloc?
Alex M: Attached snapshot (pasted):
```
GPU 0: 40%  10240MiB / 16384MiB
Processes: python(pid=2345) -> 8200MiB
Reserved: 8600MiB
Fragmentation: ~400MiB
```
Sana R: That 'Reserved' > process usage is classic fragmentation/arena growth. Might be workspace sizing from kernel selection causing many temp allocations.
Jen L: Did kernel picker recently add fused-attn path? That increases transient workspace.
Alex M: Yes, new kernel heuristics choose fused-attn for short seq, which allocs a 256MB workspace per stream. We suspected it but perf improved. Now looks like some workspaces aren't freed after exceptions.
Mike T: Could be missing cudaFree in error path. Can you run repro with env REDWOOD_ALLOC_DEBUG=1 and our alloc-trace script? It prints alloc/free stack traces.
Alex M: Ran it. Output shows a sequence of cudaMallocs without corresponding frees from kw_workspaces.cu lines 88-92.
Sana R: Share short repro script so others can run quickly.
Alex M: Pasting minimal repro:
```
# repro.sh
export REDWOOD_KP_HEUR=greedy_fuse
python -u tools/repro/run_batch.py --model redwood-small --batch-size 8 --iters 250
```
Mike T: Good. I'll run with nsight: `nsys profile -o trace ./repro.sh` and check CUDA memory timeline.
Jen L: Also try setting REDWOOD_WORKSPACE_LIMIT=64MB to force reuse path; if leak stops then workspace reclaim missing.
Alex M: Quick test: with WORKSPACE_LIMIT=64MB, memory stable. Without it climb continues.
Sana R: That points to workspace allocation site. Two action items: 1) add free-on-error in fused-attn init path; 2) add periodic allocator compacting if free pool > threshold.
Mike T: I can prototype allocator tuning: shrink max_cached_block_size and coalesce free buffers every 5 minutes. Might reduce fragmentation.
Jen L: Add unit test that runs 10k random init/error cycles to catch missing frees.
Alex M: I'll open PR with patch + repro script + profiler snapshot. PR will reference this thread.
perf-bot: Perf regression alert: canary latency improved 6% after greedy_fuse but memory growth is a blocker for prod. @Alex M filed issue INF-642.
Alex M: Thanks all — I'll attach nsys capture to INF-642 and ping for review tomorrow. :thumbsup:
